name: BACH_0128
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1]; ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 stains are drafted pending confirmation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive score; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%, test coverage 90%) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 54th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical image, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (86%–92% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu (84%) | Unanimous neighbors; close InSitu contrast |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (+1.47, contrib +1.48); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical (-1.08, contrib +0.94); scarcity favors invasion; 20/20 check [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 3, 4, 6) · context · Above typical (+1.24, contrib -0.85); descriptive only; 8/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below typical (-0.33, contrib +0.77); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (+1.57, contrib +0.76); weak, unreliable 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (top-3 deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197 excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (-0.0088 to +0.0064, unverified); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical epithelium remains duct-confined (region 9), matching InSitu contrast case BACH_0253 (84% similarity) despite scarce benign stroma.
- Saturated tile risk across all 12 regions and failed HoVer-Net cell segmentation mask focal non-invasive features.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 5**: Confirm true stromal infiltration before approving drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 stain orders.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 6**: Assess dense TILs and mitotic figures directly, since mitoses and lobule concepts are unreliable.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Evaluate duct confinement (region 9) and stroma (region 8) to rule out InSitu carcinoma.
